riskClass.description: Risk class. It caps the status age, the allowed channels and the biometric requirement.

channels.description: Channels the checkpoint accepts. The risk class limits them; qr_oneway exists only in the low class.

maxStatusAgeSeconds.description: S: the oldest status list, in seconds, that the checkpoint accepts.

statusRefreshSeconds.description: Delta: how often a status list is refreshed, in seconds. Not larger than S.

oneWayTokenMaxAgeSeconds.description: Longest accepted lifetime of a one-way token, in seconds. At most 30.

requireBiometric.description: Whether the holder must pass a biometric check before presenting.

issuers.description: 'self' is the verifier's own issuer, 'registry' is any issuer of the trusted-issuer registry, a list names issuers by identifier.

accepted.description: Credential types the checkpoint accepts and their issuers.

requestedClaims.description: Claims the verifier asks the holder to disclose. 'delegation' is never listed; it accompanies 'authority'.

authority.description: Power of authority to check. Needs authority among the requested claims.

unit.description: Unit of the amount; compared as an exact string.

amountSource.description: 'request' takes the amount from the presentation request, 'fixed' uses fixedAmount.

fixedAmount.description: Amount to check when amountSource is 'fixed'.

openSeconds.description: How long the relay stays switched on, in seconds.

title: UMIS checkpoint policy
description: What one verification point accepts, how fresh its status data must be and what it asks for.
